verdict.rationale: Mercury's first-party MCP server lets users connect AI assistants and ask natural-language questions such as "What's my balance today?" and "Graph my last 6 months of transactions" against accounts, transactions, recipients and cards. Official agent skills also drive the Mercury CLI for tasks like spend analysis and receipt upload. Missing for 10: clear evidence that write operations (payments, invoices) can be run by natural-language command rather than only read queries; any native in-app natural-language interface (natural language works only through external AI clients); independent or hands-on corroboration.
